subject: Dynamic-capacity tables
notes: kb/Work PB1269 + PB1144 (landed w67o). 8.5.1.9.6 1): EC-BOUND-OVERFLOW exists when an operation causes the expected capacity to be exceeded; an implicit change to a table already past it raises nothing; RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT lets the operation continue. Every IMPLICIT change now raises through ONE site, CobolDynTable.RaiseImplicitOverflow (first-crossing guard), BEFORE the change: the receiving-subscript growth (RefReceiving) and the 14.6.9.2 recreation (FromCurrentImage, which used to route through SetCapacity and raise the SET's EC-BOUND-SET instead). ExceptionEngine.BoundOverflowError passes nextStatementContinues, so a RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT returns to the raise site and the growth and the store complete (was: RaiseResumeSignal unwound before GrowTo, capacity stayed 2). Witnesses: pb1269 (DECL once, CAP 6, E6=022, then CAP 7 with no second call); pb1144 C1-C3 (MOVE S TO R to capacity 6 raises EC-BOUND-OVERFLOW, the second MOVE nothing).
